- the office space occupied for the purpose of the action as a percentage of the total available office space.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A description of the project office, the services or resources it makes available, its overall capacity (where applicable), the costs to be apportioned and the proposed distribution key have to be included in the proposal. 
The proposed cost apportionment approach has to be presented as an annex to the budget. The budgeted amount of the costs for which apportionment is proposed has to be indicated in the column "TOTAL COSTS" and "APPORTIONMENT" has to be indicated in the column "units". The proposed cost apportionment approach will be assessed by the evaluation committee and the contracting authority. If the proposed cost apportionment approach is not accepted, there are two options: 1) adjust the distribution key in line with the conclusions of the evaluation committee;  2) exclude the costs from the budget.
